backup.production_rule: D-348 staff pay ahead. staff_pay_requests.lines may now also hold kind 'advance' lines made by the cleaner herself: new staff_pay_request_create_v2(sessions, claim_ids, extras, advance, key) = the live v1 body plus the advance block of staff_pay_admin_create_v2 (refusals advance_not_owed, advance_taken + ref, no_rate, transport_not_allowed, bad_request on a repeated or malformed date; the 20-line cap and no_lines count advance lines; payee = auth.uid()). staff_pay_request_create_v1 becomes a wrapper passing '[]' (guard: live v1 body md5 374416fd95fcc1c0668ab5b486eb2f2d, the 20261005 text with the 20261007 Manila patch; candidates guard md5 2db19457e15a84197caef16c1d2f4123 = the s94 body). staff_pay_candidates_v1 gains key advance [{checkout_date, base, transport}] (dates and prices only, no guest names; every existing key unchanged). New table staff_report_reminders (RLS on, no policy, service_role only) and four service_role-only functions: staff_report_reminders_due_v1 (stage 1 after 1 day, stage 3 after 3 days, 08:00-19:59 Manila, requests of the last 30 days, owed_dates per payee; an unsent claim older than 1 hour counts as not taken, A1), staff_report_reminder_claim_v1 (insert or take over a stale unsent claim), _release_v1, _sent_v1. Grants restated on every function (ML-21): create_v2 and create_v1 authenticated only (service_role revoked explicitly), candidates authenticated + service_role, reminder functions service_role only. No existing row is changed.
backup.notes: Phase is backfill only because release_v1 contains DELETE FROM (the expand-phase scanner refuses that text; s96 did the same): it deletes only unsent reminder claims, nothing existing. Otherwise additive. One new table, five new functions, two bodies replaced (one as a wrapper). Old Staff apps keep working: no key removed from any payload and old clients never send advance. Deploy order: SQL first, then waves (notify-cleaner-payment calls create_v2; release-expired-holds runs the reminder drain), then the Staff app. WAVES falls back to create_v1 on PGRST202 when the advance list is empty, so a waves deploy before SQL is safe for ordinary requests. The live md5 of staff_pay_request_create_v1 could not be read offline: it is computed from the repo text plus the 20261007 Manila patch (the same method reproduces the live candidates md5 6cdafb8627ee6d3081a486ccd832ee66); if the guard stops the apply with 55000, re-cut from the live body.

rollback.safe_until: Always while no open cleaner-made request holds an advance line (the rollback refuses otherwise: cancel or settle it first). Reminder rows are lost on rollback (they only gate a push). Paid advance requests, their cleanadv expense rows and linked sessions stay.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261101_s99_staff_pay_ahead.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh. It restores staff_pay_request_create_v1 and staff_pay_candidates_v1 byte for byte, drops create_v2, the four reminder functions and staff_report_reminders. Roll the Staff and waves deploys back first.
